qcReview.tool: scripts/data/qc_render.py <packId> <outDir> [--crop]: decodes the packed DICOM and draws every reference target on it (contour sets on the image with the largest outlined area), so a shifted, flipped or misplaced outline would show
qcReview.selectionRule: NIH ChestX-ray14 PA films of adults (18-90) with a radiologist box whose label is also in the report labels, one film per patient, no patient of an earlier pack and no film reviewed in rounds 1 or 4.
qcReview.review: Every candidate drawn with its boxes (full film and zoom) and kept only where the boxed finding is clearly visible.
